rv.q: But the structure of the piece needs a whole lot more work.
LAYALINA is a heartwarming multigenerational family play that spans from Baghdad to Skokie.
But in some ways, this intensely positive vision of familial love drives the second act towards over-sweet patness.
With moving performances and a deeply impactful story, Layalina is simply a must-see.
Layalina‘s insistence on the persistence of joy is wholly radical.
This is truly a gem of gender splendor.
A wonderful moment, it hints at 'Layalina's' potential, which some revising may well unlock.
The ability of each performer to become a different personality is special and the story is one that teaches us about life in a culture that was different than our own.

cn.t: Critics find this multigenerational Iraqi-American family drama heartwarming but uneven, with a disjointed structure spanning Baghdad to Skokie. The play earns praise for its cultural authenticity and emotional resonance despite familiar immigrant story tropes.
